aspects.name: Transhuman Transgender Engineer
aspects.description:
* Voice synth/modulation
* Equipment compartments
* Recording software
* Advanced audio/visual sensors
* Oxygen recycler
* Integrated smart phone/computer for communications

aspects.name: Cyborg "Menace"
aspects.description: To be clear, Delilah is not a cyborg menace; she just has to deal with humans who think that she is.

aspects.name: God Damn Chairs
aspects.description:
Delilah's 10 foot long body does not allow her to be comfortable in most human sized spaces.

For example, Delilah must coil up in the cargo section of the space elevator when she travels the planet.

stunts.name: Restraint Protocols
stunts.description: Because ***I have programmed my multiple robotic arms and other limbs to do so***, I can use _Engineering_ instead of _Fight_ to Grapple Opponents in a Conflict

stunts.name: Cybernetic metal is tougher than your average bear
stunts.description: Because I have an enormous metal cybernetic body, I get an extra Mild (2) Consequence slot that can only be used for physical consequences.

stunts.name: Self-Repair Protocol
stunts.description: Because ***I've engineered my own cyberbody***, in the scene after I receive a moderate consequence, my automatic self-repair protocol reduces it to a mild consequence, and automatically makes a successful recover roll for that mild consequence.
